create_alphafold3_from_yaml: create an Alphafold3 model instance from a YAML config file path and optional dotpath
create_trainer_from_yaml: create a Trainer instance from a YAML config file with model, dataset, and fabric arguments
create_trainer_from_conductor_yaml: create a multi-stage Trainer from a conductor YAML config with training order and nested checkpoints
build_alphafold3_config: build an Alphafold3Config Pydantic model with dimension, bin, and loss weight parameters
build_trainer_config: build a TrainerConfig Pydantic model with training steps, batch size, checkpoint, and dataset settings
build_conductor_config: build a ConductorConfig Pydantic model with multiple trainer configs and a validated training order
build_weighted_pdb_sampler_config: build a WeightedPDBSamplerConfig with chain and interface mapping file paths
build_dataset_config: build a DatasetConfig specifying pdb or atom dataset type with train and validation folders
run_yaml_config_to_dict: run a YAML config file path and return its parsed dictionary contents
run_safe_deep_get: run safe nested dictionary access via dotpath notation with a default fallback value
